messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Use the provided camera reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use video 0 as the starting point and apply the following edit to it: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from the side. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands still, then raises their arms to cross them over their chest, holds the pose briefly, and lowers their arms back to their sides.","camera":"Static, medium full shot from the side at eye level.","clothing":"A light blue and white patterned long-sleeve sweater, light purple pants, tan socks, and brown shoes.","hair_color":"Light brown or dark blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, neatly styled hair with a side part.","identity":"A slim young person with a fair complexion, shown in profile facing right.","scene":"An outdoor urban rooftop or plaza with a large gray metal structure behind the person, wet pavement, and city buildings in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the same person in a static full-body side view, framed from head to shoes and positioned near the center-left in front of a large gray metal structure, matching the reference framing. The arm-raising, crossing, and lowering action remains visible with a similar progression.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a full-body side shot matching the reference image's viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, clothing, expression, action timing, and scene.
uncertain: Whether the side-view action timing exactly matches the source frame-by-frame.
unexpected_changes: The scene background changed from the original street with storefronts and cranes to a different rooftop/plaza area with a large gray metal structure and different surrounding buildings.
